id: title:jurajmajerik:re run metric loads when recalc flag resolves late

review.posthog_relevance: Adds cache state and refresh/load re-execution checks for a branch flag, potentially improving consistency of cached flag values against stored branch state.
review.reason: Adds branch flag values and refresh arguments to cache, and re-runs refresh or load if a later flag update contradicts the stored branch value. This could help maintain cache consistency, but the exact benefit and PostHog relevance are not established.
review.uncertainty: The exact benefit and PostHog relevance are not established.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a test and implementation change. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a branch flag value and last refresh args to cache, and re-runs refresh if flag value contradicts stored branch value.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if a later flag update contradicts the value used for a refresh; if so, re-runs the refresh with stored arguments.
